# Quiz Runner

## Summary
Intro → one question at a time with progress and countdown → result with every question revealed; submits through Take Quiz.

## Usage
`<QuizRunner @quiz @enrollment @context @attemptsUsed />`

## Non-goals
No question authoring.

## Example
The linked enrolment offers its released quizzes through this runner.
attributes.cardDescription: A quiz from intro to result: one question at a time with progress and countdown, then every answer revealed.
